newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah steady in narrow range trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah steady in narrow range trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was steady against the dollar in dull early trading on Monday.
"Trading is fairly slow. Focus is still on liquidity," one European bank dealer said.
Dealers said the rupiah firmed at the opening on fears of possible tightening due to Tuesday's weekly tax payments. But anticipation seemed to change as tom/next rates were stable.
They said there were some dollar purchases as the money market was not as tight as widely feared, but rates were still trapped in a narrow range between 2,428.0 and 2,429.0.
Spot rupiah was at 2,428.1/28.5 at 0300 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,427.5/28.5. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,427.9/28.3 and 2,427.5/28.00, respectively.
Overnight swap was at 0.35/0.45 and tom/next at 0.25/0.28.
One Japanese bank dealer said longer-term swaps softened slightly, suggesting offshore players unloading some of their long forward positions established previously.

Dealers said there was no reaction in the market to weekend riots in East Java as a Moslem crowd burned shops, a Protestant church and a Buddhist temple. Calm had returned to the town of Bangkalan on Madura island on Sunday

The incident follows a number of violent attacks on government buildings in various towns on Madura since the general election on May 29 was won by the ruling Golkar party amid claims from rivals of widespread polling irregularities.
Dealers said offshore operators appeared to take such incidents in their stride and were mainly focussed on Jakarta.
One-month swaps were at 12.25/13.00, two at 25.50/26.50, three at 39.0/40.0 and six at 80.0/81.0 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,421/2,613 and its conversion band at 2,421/2,469 on Friday.
